subject: Post-upgrade decode errors & throughput spike — CieloHealth escalation
messages:
From: Sam Wong <sam.wong@cielohealth.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Cc: sre@cielohealth.com, platform@cielohealth.com
Date: 2027-12-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Immediate: post-upgrade latency + decode errors (prod)

Evelyn —

We pushed your recommended model upgrade this morning (redwood-model-v2.4, qprofile=q2) and immediately started seeing a production impact. P95 latency has increased ~3x for our short-text path, and we're also seeing ~4–6% decode/error responses where the model returns truncated or malformed outputs (examples attached).

This is affecting our triage workflow; as of now ~12% of requests hit the degraded path and we’re seeing user complaints. Can you confirm whether this qprofile is known to cause these sorts of short-sequence decode regressions? We need an emergency mitigation plan — either a rollback or a safe config to pin responses to the previous profile.

Attaching a small perf sample and a few example outputs: perf_sample.tar.gz

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Wong
SRE Lead, CieloHealth
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
To: Sam Wong <sam.wong@cielohealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-15T09:39:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: post-upgrade latency + decode errors (prod)

Sam — thanks for the quick heads up and the attachments. I'm escalating this to our infra/quant team for immediate triage. A few quick asks while we investigate:

- Can you confirm the percent of traffic on the short-text path vs. long-form?
- Are the malformed outputs concentrated on particular request sizes or tokens?
- Please keep the perf sample coming if you see new examples.

Karthik / Laura — assigning to you for urgent analysis. Initial priority: determine whether qprofile=q2 (the new quant profile) is changing decode behavior for short sequences or if kernel selection on the host is causing stalls. If this is the qprofile, prepare a rollback recipe we can execute for this account (canary -> full).

I'll patch the customer with next steps within 30 minutes.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: sam.wong@cielohealth.com
Date: 2027-12-15T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: post-upgrade latency + decode errors (prod)

Evelyn / Laura / Sam — quick triage notes based on the perf sample and early logs:

- We see a significant increase in tokenization+decode CPU time for sequences < 48 tokens when qprofile=q2 is used on the current kernel. Kernel path chooses a different int8 path that appears to mis-handle certain EOS token edge-cases, leading to truncated outputs (explains the malformed responses).
- Throughput drop looks correlated with continuous batching getting reset by higher tail latencies; p95 rises quickly on short sequences.

Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) Temporary rollback to redwood-model-v2.3 + qprofile=q1 for the CieloHealth production alias (canary -> 100% over 20m). Low-risk; restores prior behavior.
2) Runtime patch: force alternate kernel selection for short sequences (requires a fast rollout to the serving pool, 45–90m ETA).
3) Config-level throttle: force smaller batch windows for short-text routes to avoid large qbatch stalls (mitigates p95 but doesn’t fix decode errors).

I recommend option 1 as fastest. Laura: can you validate the rollback playbook and estimate impact to throughput (tokens/s) and cost delta? Sam: if you approve rollback, we’ll start canary immediately and report metrics every 5 minutes.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Inference Optimization
From: Sam Wong <sam.wong@cielohealth.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, platform@cielohealth.com
Date: 2027-12-15T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: post-upgrade latency + decode errors (prod)

Evelyn / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick analysis. Confirming: our short-text path is ~35% of traffic during the morning window. We’ve captured a handful of truncated outputs (support_stacktrace.log attached) and the business impact is material — downstream triage automation is failing and manual work is increasing. We approve the rollback to v2.3 + qprofile=q1 immediately. Please start canary and keep us posted every 5 minutes.

If you need authorization to apply an emergency credit or SLA concession while we remediate, I can fast-track approval from procurement — but we’ll need a documented timeline to share with our ops stakeholders.

—Sam
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Wong <sam.wong@cielohealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-15T17:43:00-08:00
Subject: Post-deploy escalation summary and exec ask — CieloHealth rollback + credit authorization

Team — final update and ask for executive approval/action. Timeline summarized below; forwarding to Marcus for approval on the customer credit and any sales concessions.

Summary:
- 09:05: v2.4 + qprofile=q2 rolled to CieloHealth production alias.
- 09:12: Customer reports p95 latency ~3x and 4–6% malformed/truncated outputs.
- 09:39: Internal triage started; suspected qprofile/kernel mismatch on short sequences.
- 10:40–11:10: Canary rollback to v2.3 + qprofile=q1 executed, canary metrics show p95 returning to baseline and malformed outputs dropping to <0.2%. Full rollback completed at 11:25.

Customer impact: ~2.5 hours of degraded experience with increased manual triage for their users. CieloHealth has requested a documented timeline for their procurement team and indicated they may request a one-time credit for the incident.

Exec asks:
- Marcus: please approve a goodwill credit up to 15% of December invoice as discussed in prior playbooks (customer is a strategic mid-market health account). If you prefer, we can offer a timeboxed credits+priority support package instead.
- Laura / Karthik: prepare a short write-up (one pager) outlining root cause (qprofile-kernel interaction), the rollback steps you ran, and a mitigation plan including a patch ETA for the kernel selection change. Add the postmortem link to the HubSpot deal record.
- Sales ops / Finance: flag deal HS-2027-0893 for potential concession and update revenue forecast accordingly.

I’ll send an external summary to Sam that includes the rollback timeline, a mitigation plan, and the offer for a credit. Putting Marcus on thread for quick sign-off so we can close the loop with the customer.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
